title: Rolu Learns to Be on Time
moral: Being on time helps you enjoy more and stay responsible.

Rolu was always late.

One day, the animals planned a race.

“Come on time!” Tina reminded him.

Rolu nodded.

“I will!”

But on the day of the race—

Rolu arrived late.

The race was already over.

scenes.summary: Rolu realizes his mistake and decides to change.
scenes.text:
Tina looked at him kindly.

“Being late makes you miss things,” she said.

Rolu felt sad.

“I don’t want to miss fun anymore,” he said.

Tina had an idea.

“Start early,” she said.

“And keep track of time.”

Rolu nodded.

“I’ll try!”

scenes.summary: Rolu starts being on time and enjoys activities with his friends.

The next day, Rolu got ready early.

He finished his tasks.

He watched the sun.

And he left on time.

Rolu reached the pond before everyone!

“I’m early!” he smiled.

He joined the games, laughed, and had fun.

Being on time helps you enjoy more.

Good habits make a big difference.

The End

story:
Rolu the Frog Who Was Always Late

In a lively pond surrounded by green reeds, lived a cheerful frog named Rolu.

Rolu loved to play, splash, and jump around.

But there was one problem…

Rolu was always late.

“Be on time!” said his friend Tina the Turtle.

“Okay!” Rolu said.

But when it was time to meet—

Rolu was still sleeping.

Or still playing.

Or still eating!

“Oops!” he said again and again.

One day, the animals planned a race.

“Come on time!” Tina reminded him.

Rolu nodded.

“I will!”

But on the day of the race—

Rolu arrived late.

The race was already over.

“Oh no!” he said.

“I missed it!”

Tina looked at him kindly.

“Being late makes you miss things,” she said.

Rolu felt sad.

“I don’t want to miss fun anymore,” he said.

Tina had an idea.

“Start early,” she said.

“And keep track of time.”

Rolu nodded.

“I’ll try!”

The next day, Rolu got ready early.

He finished his tasks.

He watched the sun.

And he left on time.

Rolu reached the pond before everyone!

“I’m early!” he smiled.

He joined the games, laughed, and had fun.

Being on time helps you enjoy more.

Good habits make a big difference.

The End
